events.continuity_hook: Opening planning session for the February Cleveland work trip.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact comparison of flight and hotel pairings, including total estimated cost, timing, transit notes, breakfast, in-room coffee, mini-fridge availability, and nearby dinner access.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol begins planning a two-night grant-site visit from Chicago to Cleveland for February 18-20, with a Tuesday afternoon arrival after an internal morning meeting, a Wednesday site visit from 9:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., and a Thursday debrief expected to end before noon. Current constraints include keeping the hotel near University Circle or an easy rideshare away, staying near the reimbursable hotel limit of $185 before taxes, avoiding a rental car, and favoring a return flight after lunch. No prior plan is in place; unresolved are the best hotel neighborhood and whether a nonstop flight premium is worth it.

events.continuity_hook: Follows the initial Cleveland scan and focuses on choosing a practical hotel before flight purchase.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the shortlisted hotels against the new meeting location, note commute times and cancellation terms, and identify the most practical booking choice.
events.scenario_brief: The Cleveland grantee has moved the first Wednesday meeting to 8:30 a.m. at a branch location east of downtown, making the morning commute more important than the evening dining scene. Marisol has kept the flight search open and now wants to narrow hotels under the reimbursement cap, especially ones with included breakfast and useful in-room amenities. Unresolved is whether a cheaper airport-area hotel is too inconvenient for the early meeting.

events.continuity_hook: Last check before ticketing the Cleveland itinerary.
events.interaction_goal: Refresh return-flight options, compare the fare difference and arrival times, and recommend the cleaner itinerary for final purchase.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol has selected a Cleveland hotel but has not finalized the airfare. The Thursday debrief has shifted to run until noon, so the earlier return option is no longer safe. Current constraints are to keep the outbound flight and hotel plan intact if possible and find a return leg leaving comfortably after lunch. Unresolved is whether to pay more for the later nonstop or accept a connection that gets home in the evening.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a separate March board-meeting episode after the Cleveland trip planning is nearly complete.
events.interaction_goal: Prepare a short table comparing flight choices and hotel options, including the room block, nearby alternatives, total cost, meeting convenience, breakfast, room amenities, and dinner access.
events.scenario_brief: A new board-meeting trip to Baltimore is added for March 12-14, with a Wednesday evening reception, a full Thursday meeting at the Inner Harbor conference hotel, and an optional Friday morning session ending around 11:00 a.m. Current constraints include using the event hotel if the block rate is reasonable, checking whether a nearby hotel with breakfast would be cheaper overall, and returning to Chicago Friday afternoon. Unresolved are the hotel choice and whether BWI flight times make more sense than a less convenient airport pairing.

events.continuity_hook: Narrowing the Baltimore stay after the meeting agenda became earlier and more hotel-centered.
events.interaction_goal: Summarize the hotel trade-off, list what to verify with the event hotel, and give a practical recommendation before the room-block deadline.
events.scenario_brief: The Baltimore organizer has added a 7:30 a.m. breakfast briefing at the event hotel and extended the room-block deadline by a few days. The event hotel is about $32 per night more than the nearby alternative and does not list free breakfast, but it removes an early-morning transfer. Unresolved is whether the convenience outweighs the added hotel cost and whether the room can be confirmed with a mini-fridge.

events.continuity_hook: First personal trip in the arc, lighter than the work trips but still organized around timing and practical hotel details.
events.interaction_goal: Compare a few weekend flight-and-hotel combinations with separate booking costs, highlighting schedule fit, hotel location, breakfast, room setup, and nearby dining.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol adds a personal weekend in Minneapolis with her spouse for April 25-27 to see a museum exhibition and have a low-key dinner with family nearby. Current constraints are a Friday departure from Chicago after the workday, a Sunday afternoon return, a walkable or easy rideshare hotel near the museum or downtown restaurants, and a sensible total cost rather than work reimbursement rules. No bookings exist yet; unresolved is whether a bundled flight-and-hotel option beats booking the pieces separately.
